exposure: partial avulsion of the puborectalis muscle
complete avulsion of the puborectalis muscle
outcome: changes in global strain of the puborectalis muscle
finding: Spontaneous or operative vaginal birth and complete bilateral avulsion of the puborectalis muscle negatively influence the strain of the puborectalis muscle.
mod_finding: Global strain of the puborectalis muscle diminished significantly after spontaneous or operative vaginal delivery, but no significant change was observed after Cesarean delivery.
